title: Regional Sales Director (Western Europe)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Skeletons, lasers, tattoo buses — the Torq brand grabs attention like nothing else in cybersecurity. And we're growing like crazy, backed by Series D funding, 200% employee growth, and 300% revenue growth. Fueling Torq's momentum is our game-changing AI SOC platform, backed by a team and culture that makes Torq one of Forbes' Best Startup Employers in America, and a Business Insider 'startup to bet your career on'.</p> <p>Life at Torq is all gas, no brakes. We're a team of relentless, collaborative go-getters pushing the boundaries of what's possible for security automation. Every role is an essential driver of Torq's success as the AI-native autonomous SecOps platform of choice for security teams across the Fortune 500. </p></div><p>Over the past year, we've built one of the fastest-growing Enterprise Sales organizations in EMEA. Now we're looking for a hands-on <strong>Regional Sales Director</strong> to lead our Western Europe business across the UK, Ireland, France, Benelux, and Northern Europe.<br>This isn't a role for someone who wants to manage from behind a dashboard. We're looking for a leader who enjoys being in the field, building pipeline alongside the team, partnering with customers, and helping experienced Enterprise sellers win bigger.</p> <p><strong>Location:</strong> London, UK (preferred)</p> <h2><strong>What you'll do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Lead, coach, and develop a team of Enterprise Account Executives across Western Europe.</li> <li>Own the regional sales strategy and execution to achieve ambitious growth targets.</li> <li>Drive pipeline generation, forecasting, operational excellence, and accurate sales execution.</li> <li>Partner closely with customers, Sales Engineers, Marketing, and Channel teams to accelerate strategic opportunities.</li> <li>Support the team throughout complex enterprise sales cycles, from prospecting to closed deals.</li> <li>Identify new business opportunities and expand Torq's presence across the region.</li> <li>Recruit, hire, and develop top-performing Enterprise sales talent.</li> <li>Represent Torq at customer meetings, executive briefings, and industry events.</li> <li>Foster a high-performance culture built on coaching, accountability, and collaboration.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>We're looking for someone who</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Has 4+ years of experience leading Enterprise Security Sales teams.</li> <li>Has previous experience as an Enterprise Account Executive selling complex cybersecurity or cloud security solutions.</li> <li>Has a proven track record of consistently exceeding revenue targets.</li> <li>Has led experienced Enterprise or Strategic sellers.</li> <li>Is passionate about coaching, developing people, and leading from the front.</li> <li>Thrives in fast-moving, high-growth environments.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why Torq?</strong></h2> <p>You'll join one of the fastest-growing AI SOC companies in the market, leading one of our most strategic regions during an exciting phase of growth.<br>This is an opportunity to build a world-class team, shape the future of our Western Europe business, and make a significant impact on Torq's continued success.<br>If you're excited about building teams, creating momentum, and winning together- we'd love to meet you.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><em>We build AI for a living,  and we encourage candidates to use it to prep, research, and sharpen their best work. But we're hiring humans, not chatbots. We want the real you.  Use AI to tighten your resume, prep for interviews, research Torq, and outline ideas for written responses. Show up as yourself for live interviews, final assessments (the voice, logic, and reasoning need to be yours), and anywhere we're evaluating how you think — not how you prompt.</em></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 10pt;"><em>Excited about our vision and ready to make an impact as we grow? title: Senior Business Operations Lead
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><h2><strong>The Community You Will Join</strong></h2> <p>The Chief Business Officer organization drives company-wide growth and global expansion. </p> <p>This is the role that turns Airbnb's ambition for the UKI & Nordics into a plan and holds the organisation to delivering it: shaping strategy, aligning cross-functional teams, and driving sustainable commercial growth across one of our most important regions.</p> <p>This includes recruiting and supporting high-quality Stays, Experiences, and Services, alongside executing Airbnb’s global market strategy. Shaping business approaches, quality supply sourcing, and international growth efforts are integral to the team’s success in connecting millions more hosts and guests to Airbnb's platform.</p> <h2><strong>The Difference You Will Make</strong></h2> <p>You will join the UKI, Nordics, Middle East and Africa team, covering one of Airbnb’s largest and most mature markets alongside five of Europe’s most digitally advanced, high-trust travel markets. The UK offers scale, brand strength, and a sophisticated regulatory environment; the Nordics offer strong domestic travel behaviour and significant headroom for growth. Together they make this one of the most commercially interesting regions in EMEA to build in.</p> <h2><strong>A Typical Day</strong></h2> <p>You will own the business operations agenda for the UKI and Nordics. Airbnb’s most established European market alongside five high-potential Nordic markets (Sweden, Denmark, Norway, Finland). Partnering closely with the Country Manager, you will set the regional growth strategy, translate it into a plan cross-functional teams can execute against, and run the operating rhythm that keeps it on track. This is a high-visibility role: your influence will come from the quality of your thinking and your ability to mobilise teams to grow further.</p> <h3><strong>Regional growth strategy</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the UKI & Nordics growth strategy end to end: define where the region should compete, what it should stop doing, and the handful of bets that will move guest nights, supply growth, and revenue.</li> <li>Build the annual and quarterly plan with the Country Manager, sizing opportunities and making explicit recommendations on where to deploy marketing spend, supply investment, and partnership effort.</li> <li>Set and pressure-test the region’s targets, translating global goals into market-level commitments that supply, marketing, partnerships, policy, and product teams can own.</li> <li>Run deep-dive analyses on demand and supply dynamics, competitive movements, pricing, and seasonality, turning each into a clear recommendation, not just a read-out.</li> <li>Identify and stand up new growth initiatives, using the UK as a test market for offerings that can then scale across EMEA, and the Nordics as a proving ground for high-penetration, low-friction market plays.</li> <li>Build the case for investment in the region: sizing, business case, and the socialisation needed to win resource in global planning cycles.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Operating rhythm and execution</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Own the region’s operating cadence: weekly, monthly, and quarterly business reviews, so leadership has a single, trusted view of performance and the story behind it.</li> <li>Convert strategy into sequenced execution plans with named owners, milestones, and success measures across supply, marketing, partnerships, policy, and product.</li> <li>Track delivery against the plan, surfacing risks and bottlenecks early and driving them to resolution rather than escalating them.</li> <li>Design and continuously improve the operating processes the region runs on, raising the bar on efficiency, transparency, and decision speed.</li> <li>Lead the region’s input into global planning and resource allocation cycles.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Cross-functional leadership</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Act as the connective tissue between the UKI & Nordics team and global functions such as Product, Marketing, Communications, Policy, Finance, Data Science, Legal, and Community Support.</li> <li>Be the go-to decision partner alongside the Country Manager: the person other teams come to for the region’s position, context, and priorities.</li> <li>Build alignment on high-priority projects, market launches, and product tests, brokering trade-offs between global consistency and local market reality.</li> <li>Represent UKI & Nordics in NEMEA and global business operations forums, and bring the best of what other markets are doing back into the region.</li> <li>Partner with Public Policy on the regulatory landscape, including short-term let rules in the UKI and Nordic city regulation so commercial plans account for policy risk and opportunity.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Insights and storytelling</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Turn complex data into clear narratives that help leadership decide with a recommendation attached.</li> <li>Build the reporting layer the region relies on: dashboards, performance packs, and executive materials, working with a dedicated analyst.</li> <li>Establish the metrics that matter for the region and hold the team to a shared definition of success.</li> <li>Champion data-driven decision-making, and use AI tooling to compress the time from question to insight. Automating recurring analysis and reporting so the team spends its time on judgement, not assembly.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Your Expertise</strong></h2> <p>To deliver in this role, Airbnb is seeking candidates with:</p> <ul> <li>12+ years in business operations, strategy, consulting, or commercial leadership, with a track record of owning outcomes in a market or business unit</li> <li>Demonstrated ability to set strategy and drive it through to execution </li> <li>Deep experience influencing without authority across a global matrixed organisation</li> <li>Strong analytical toolkit; comfortable working with finance and data science partners and interrogating the numbers yourself</li> <li>Exceptional written and verbal communication, with executive presence in front of senior leadership</li> <li>Comfort with ambiguity, and a strong bias toward action and ownership</li> <li>Practical fluency with AI tools and a view on where they change how a team operates</li> <li>Familiarity with the UKI and/or Nordic markets, or comparable mature-market experience</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Additional</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience in a two-sided marketplace, travel/hospitality, or consumer tech</li> <li>Experience launching or scaling new products or lines of business in-market</li> <li style="font-weight: bold;"><strong>This role will require to be in the London office 3 days per week. </strong></li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;"><strong>Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:</strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</span></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">How We'll Take Care of You:</span></strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.</span></p></div><div class="title">United Kingdom Annual Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£126,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£158,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Reasonable Accommodations:</strong> We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>A Note on Recruiting Scams:</strong> Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @<a href="http://airbnb.com">airbnb.com</a> or @<a href="http://ext.airbnb.com">ext.airbnb.com</a> email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.</span></p> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Research Scientist - Control & Machine Learning
description: At Gigaton, we’re on a mission to cut gigatonnes of carbon emissions from the world’s biggest emitting industries (like cement, steel and glass), by building autonomous AI control and optimisation systems that learn and leverage the physics of manufacturing. Our products run heavy industrial plants more efficiently, more stably, and with lower emissions in real time - laying the foundation for the next industrial revolution. We are a team of scientists, engineers, builders, and operators who love hard problems, have high standards, and want to make change happen in the physical world. We care about deep tech, but we care even more about whether it delivers cost and carbon impact in a live plant, with real people, under real constraints. With Gigaton, you’ll solve really tough problems in places few people ever get close to, and build something that actually helps the planet. Are you up for the challenge? Research questions you could initially work on Learning dynamics from operational data. How can we identify useful models of a plant from noisy, partially observed data collected during closed-loop control? Optimising under uncertainty. How can Bayesian optimisation improve plant performance when experiments are expensive, samples are noisy, and operating constraints must be respected? Learning while controlling. How can we use dual control and active learning to choose actions that improve performance while gathering information about uncertain dynamics? Learning across plants. Which parts of a model or control strategy can transfer between plants, and how can we adapt them efficiently to a new site? These are meant as examples rather than an exhaustive list. We’re looking for someone who can bring depth to a relevant area, identify promising connections, and help us decide which problems to tackle next. Your main responsibilities As a Research Scientist, you’ll: Help shape our research and development agenda, turning challenges from live plants into well-defined research problems. Develop and implement methods for modelling, identification, optimisation and control of complex physical systems. Design rigorous experiments, establish strong baselines and understand when and why a method works. Work with process engineers to incorporate plant physics, operating knowledge and constraints into models and algorithms. Work with machine learning and deployment engineers to evaluate promising methods and bring them into production. Follow deployed performance, investigate failures, and use what you learn to guide further research. Communicate your findings clearly and contribute to the team’s scientific understanding. What a great fit looks like A PhD in control, machine learning, applied mathematics, engineering, physics or a related field, or equivalent research experience. A strong research background in one or more of control theory, data-driven control, system identification, Bayesian optimisation, probabilistic modelling, physics-informed machine learning, imitation learning or model-based reinforcement learning . Evidence that you can formulate a research question, develop a method and evaluate it carefully, through publications, open-source work or applied research. Strong Python skills and experience implementing machine learning models using tools such as Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, PyTorch. An interest in working closely with engineers and taking responsibility for how your methods perform in practice. Practical experience deploying machine learning and control algorithms. A strong interest in climate mitigation. You don’t need to know about cement. You do need to get excited about the physics, willing to learn from operators and process engineers, and keen to understand why a plant behaves the way it does. We don’t expect you to tick every box. If you bring depth in a relevant area and these problems excite you, we’d like to hear from you. In return for your hard work, we’ll give you 📈 Equity in the company: When we win, you win. You’ll get share options, so you’re part of our journey from the inside. 🕰️ Flexible working We trust you to know how and when you work best and to work that out with your team. 🌴 30 days of holiday (plus bank holidays). Rest is productive. Take the time you need to recharge 🪙 A generous pension scheme. We’re planning for the future in more ways than one. Our Operating Principles ↗️ Go Gig or Go Home : High Bar, All In. What we do matters to humanity, to our customers and to each other. We hold ourselves to an extraordinarily high bar and bring the urgency this mission requires. 🏭 Concrete Honesty : Be honest. As concrete forms the foundation of our world, genuine honesty and transparency are the bedrock of our culture. 🦾 Autonomous Ownership : High agency, high ownership. We build systems that take control and make things better. We do the same: see it, own it, drive it. 😄 Cement it with Kindness & Fun : Have fun, be kind. We're here to extend Earth's life, but ours is still limited. We want to enjoy the ride. To see these in full, go to Gigaton’s Operating Principles Notion page. description: About Us Since 2003, Luzern eCommerce has been helping leading global brands grow their online business. The Senior eCommerce Content Strategist owns content strategy and execution across Amazon and the wider commerce ecosystem for Luzern's enterprise brand clients. Amazon is the primary focus — listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related content — but the role is deliberately platform-agnostic in outlook, extending strategy and content guidance to other marketplaces, retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando,Otto) and D2C. The role is audit-led: content strategy is built from a structured read of customer and platform signals — reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers put to AI assistants and platform agents — combined with a quality assessment of current content (using a framework such as IDQ or equivalent) against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements. Strategy, messaging and content requirements follow from that evidence base, rather than from assumption. A defining part of the role is thinking beyond traditional platform search: strategies must consider how content needs to be structured and prepared to be discovered and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g. Amazon's Rufus), alongside conventional marketplace and retailer search algorithms. The role sits as the senior content specialist within a small delivery pod, working alongside an SEO Executive and Designers. It carries direct client-facing responsibility: estimating, briefing, managing feedback and contributing to proposals and is responsible for reviewing the pod's output before it reaches the client. It does not carry resourcing, project management or formal line management responsibility. Tasks What You’ll Be Doing Content Audits & Quality Assessment ● Signal analysis: analyse customer reviews, search terms, AI-generated summaries, and the queries customers and AI agents put to platforms (e.g. Rufus prompts), to understand what content needs to do and where current content falls short. ● Quality benchmarking — review current platform content and score it against a content quality framework (e.g. IDQ or equivalent), benchmarking against Best-in-Class competitors and audience requirements. ● Findings to action — translate audit findings into a clear, prioritised view of content requirements that feeds directly into strategy. Content Strategy Development ● Amazon content ownership- develop and own content strategy and execution for listings, A+/Premium A+ Content, Brand Store and related Amazon content, as the role's primary focus. ● Cross-platform extension — extend strategy and content recommendations to other marketplaces,retailer sites (e.g. Tesco, Zalando, Otto) and D2C storefronts, adapting to each platform's content rules, algorithm and customer behaviour. ● Strategic framework - from audit findings, develop comms objectives, key messages and a messaging hierarchy for each client or category. ● Content requirements - define the content requirements, imagery and copy needed to deliverthe strategy, and the frameworks/guidelines the team and client can act on. ● Wireframes & mock-ups - develop A+ and Brand Store wireframes and mock-ups in collaborationwith the Designer, turning strategy into an executable creative direction. AI & Agentic Discoverability ● AI-ready content — build content strategies that account for how product and brand content is read, ranked and surfaced by generative AI assistants (e.g. ChatGPT) and in-platform shopping agents (e.g Rufus), alongside traditional search. ● Point of view — keep Luzern's thinking on AI/agentic discoverability current, and translate emerging platform and LLM behaviour into practical, sellable content recommendations. ● Alignment with SEO — partner with the SEO Executive so keyword and search strategy and content structure are aligned across traditional and AI-mediated discovery. Testing & Performance Monitoring ● A/B testing — recommend and run A/B tests (e.g. on A+ Content, Brand Store, imagery and messaging) to determine the most effective executional approach, rather than relying on opinion or precedent. ● Monitoring set-up - set up monitoring using Compass (or equivalent) to measure content effectiveness and implementation. ● Reporting on impact — track and report on content performance against strategy objectives, feeding learnings back into future audits and strategy. Creative Briefing & Review ● Strategic foundation - develop the strategy and messaging that underpins paid social, display and marketplace advertising content. ● Creative briefs - write and own briefs for Designers producing static and video ad assets, translating strategy into clear creative direction. ● Creative review - review creative output against the brief, brand guidelines and platform requirements before client delivery. Client Management ● Client-facing delivery - present content strategy, recommendations and audit findings directly to client stakeholders. ● Estimates & scoping - prepare estimates and scopes of work for content workstreams. ● Briefs — shape and write content and creative briefs in response to client requirements. ● Feedback management — manage client feedback through to resolution, balancing client expectations against strategy and platform best practice. ● Proposals — contribute to and help prepare proposals and pitch content for new and existing client business. Quality & Output Review ● Senior review — review the SEO Executive's and Designers' work before it is sent to the client, checking it against strategy, brand guidelines and platform requirements. ● Direction — give feedback and direction to keep output consistent and on-strategy. AI-Enabled Working ● AI as a working method — use AI tools proficiently for content and competitive audits, for generating recommendations, and for producing or accelerating creative and written content — not only as a subject of strategy. ● Continuous improvement — identify and recommend where AI tools can improve the speed or quality of content production and audit work across the team. description: Hi there! Thanks for stopping by 👋 Are you actively looking for a new opportunity? Or just checking the market? Well… you might just be in the right place! Lightspeed is looking for a motivated Field Sales Account Executive to join our growing EMEA Hospitality team. Based in London, you’ll play a key role in building strong relationships across your region, supporting hospitality businesses in finding the right solutions, and guiding them through their entire journey with Lightspeed - from first conversations to long-term partnerships. Our Hospitality team is expanding to meet growing demand. After refining our approach at a smaller scale, we’re now excited to grow our team and extend our impact. What you'll be doing: Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the London hospitality industry to spot trends and opportunities. Leverage market research and insights to shape effective territory sales plans. Engage prospects through high-velocity in-person meetings, outreach, and tailored presentations to convert them into loyal customers. Lead your territory with an entrepreneurial mindset, delivering consistent revenue growth. Guide clients from needs analysis and solution design through proposals, contract agreements, and seamless onboarding. Deliver engaging presentations showcasing Lightspeed’s POS and hospitality technology suite. Keep Salesforce data precise and current to streamline reporting and forecasting. Drive outbound initiatives and attend industry events to expand qualified leads. Provide customer feedback to sales and marketing teams to refine strategies and achieve collective targets. What you need to bring: Proven Field Sales and Outbound Sales experience, ideally within technology, SaaS, or hospitality sales. Deep understanding of the hospitality industry, including different segments (restaurants, cafés, bars, hotels) and their unique needs. Solid grasp of sales development best practices: pipeline building, territory planning, lead generation, and new business development. Strong time management and organisational skills - you know how to prioritise and plan your week effectively. Excellent customer service, communication, and presentation skills A track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets (monthly, quarterly, and annual), contributing directly to regional growth goals. Hands-on experience with Salesforce CRM or a similar system to manage leads, opportunities, and sales pipelines. Comfortable using data to make informed decisions - you take a data-driven approach to sales performance. Highly motivated, competitive, and confident in a quota-driven environment. Entrepreneurial and adaptable mindset - proactive, agile, and quick to adjust to evolving business goals. What's in it for you? title: People Operations Partner
description: 📈 Who We Are: We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair. Our goal is to put power back where it belongs, in the hands of customers and to take on one of the most critical problems of our century, access to low cost electricity. tem exists to fix a broken global energy market that’s long favoured legacy operators, intermediaries, and opaque pricing. Today’s electricity system was not designed for rapid decarbonisation, AI-driven efficiency or fair access for the actual users - businesses and generators. We’ve built the first AI native transaction infrastructure to reinvent how electricity is bought, sold and priced. Our technology is designed to cut out the inefficient fees, automate complex market flows, and bring transparency and fairness to energy transactions at scale. In late 2025, after extraordinary growth, we closed a $75 million Series B - led by Lightspeed Venture Partners with participation from Albion, Atomico, Allianz, Hitachi Ventures, Hitachi Ventures, Schroders Capital and others - positioning us for global expansion, deeper product innovation and category leadership. We’re scaling internationally and building toward a future where AI-driven infrastructure is foundational to electricity markets worldwide. Since launch, our modern utility product, known as RED, has already facilitated thousands of business customers and billions in energy transaction value, proving that modern software and AI can transform an industry built on legacy systems. At tem, we’re not just building another energy company, we’re rearchitecting market infrastructure so that transparency, efficiency and sustainability become the default, not the exception. 🚀 The Role We're hiring a People Operations Partner to join our Performance team. tem is rebuilding the energy transaction - transparent, fair and built on trust. Behind that mission is a company growing fast, and a Performance team that's already lean and stretched. Core People operations needs more firepower as we scale, and there's a direct commercial angle too: a strong People Operations function is what lets new joiners ramp up and become productive faster once they arrive. This is a multi-disciplinary People Operations role at the centre of the employee lifecycle - equal parts operational delivery, automation and continuous improvement. You'll be the reliable hands keeping People processes running as we scale, from multi-country payroll to onboarding, employee changes and offboarding. You'll also build the tools, automations and lightweight AI workflows that connect our systems (Rippling, Notion, Linear, Slack, Ashby, n8n and Google Workspace), so the function doesn't need to double in size every time headcount does. In your first 12 months, you might: Take ownership of payroll across our UK and employer-of-record employees, keeping every cycle accurate and on time as pay schedules and countries multiply. Become the trusted point of contact for employees and managers, owning their queries through to resolution. Build the automations and AI-enabled workflows that remove repetitive manual work from the employee lifecycle. Turn recurring pain points into better processes, tools or self-service, and measure whether they actually worked. Move across People disciplines as priorities shift - reward and benchmarking, pensions and options administration, performance cycles, engagement and people data. 🛠️ Responsibilities Run payroll end to end: own monthly payroll across UK and employer-of-record employees - changes, corrections, off-cycle and ex-gratia payments, contractor payroll and invoicing, and country-specific items - keeping it accurate and on time as we add pay schedules and countries. Keep the lifecycle running: deliver core People operations across onboarding, employee changes, contracts and documentation, leave, mobility (visas and international moves), EOR and contractor setup, and offboarding, flexing into whatever the business needs most. Be the trusted point of contact: own employee and manager queries through to resolution with a clear response standard, rather than passing them between functions. Keep the foundations accurate: maintain employee data, documentation and systems so that everything else can depend on them. Automate the repeatable: build and maintain automations and lightweight AI-enabled tools, workflows and agents that connect Rippling, Notion, Linear, Slack, Ashby, n8n, Google Workspace and similar, and remove repetitive manual work - with controls so speed never costs accuracy, privacy or employee trust. Own the People tech stack: evolve our People technology ecosystem - evaluate emerging tools, consolidate where we can, and simplify the architecture. Improve continuously: turn recurring employee and manager pain points into better processes, tools, guidance or self-service, measure whether they worked, and give foundational People processes a named owner and a runbook someone else could follow cold. Design to delight and to scale: we treat our people like top athletes and aim to delight at every step of the employee journey, and what works at today's size shouldn't need twice the People team when headcount doubles - default to eliminating or automating work rather than administering it. Partner across the business: work with Finance, Legal, Talent, Performance Partners and functional specialists to turn People initiatives into scalable services, and build dashboards and lightweight analysis that help the team and the business make better decisions. ✅ Requirements Must-Haves You've worked in People Operations, People Services, HR Operations or another operational People role - generalists welcome - and you hold a high bar on accuracy and confidentiality. You've run payroll cycles end to end, ideally multi-country, in-house or through an employer of record. UK fundamentals (PAYE, RTI, pension auto-enrolment, statutory payments) are familiar, or clearly learnable fast if your payroll experience comes from another market. You're highly comfortable with technology: AI is part of how you work, you actively experiment with new tools and capabilities, and you can build automations through no-code or low-code tools, integrations and AI workflows. You think in systems and workflows rather than individual tasks, with a strong instinct for simplification ("why are we doing this manually?"), and you're comfortable using data to diagnose problems and make decisions. You operate effectively in ambiguity, without waiting for a perfectly defined process or remit, and you balance efficiency with empathy - People Operations is about people, not just workflows. Strong ownership instincts: when something's broken, unclear or inefficient, your instinct is to fix it, and you're willing to move across People disciplines depending on where the organisation needs you. Desirable Breadth across the People remit beyond Operations - reward and benchmarking, pensions, benefits, or performance and engagement. This role is deliberately multi-disciplinary. Familiarity with the basics of UK and EU employment law, and experience administering equity or share options (for example EMI or unapproved schemes, and cap-table tools such as Vestd). Experience supporting international employment through employers of record, and setting up or managing contractors (including off-payroll and IR35 awareness). Experience in a fast-scaling startup or scale-up, especially through a period of doubling headcount or entering new countries. 🎁 Benefits & Perks Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission. 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off. Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons. Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,400 per year for your remote setup. Up to GBP150 or EUR170 per month for wellbeing. 🤝 Interview Process We move fast. Most processes take 2 to 3 weeks from first chat to offer. If you need us to adapt anything, let us know. Intro call with our Talent team. Hiring Manager interview. Skills interview, which might include a practical exercise. Bar Raiser interview with leadership stakeholders. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for. title: Engineering Manager, Experiment Platform, Robot Software
description: Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve. We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that. Here’s what this particular role covers. 🛠️ About our Engineering Teams Robot Software builds the on-vehicle software platform that Wayve’s AI Driver runs on. Within it, the Experiment Platform team owns the systems that let our researchers develop driving models on the road: deploying models to vehicles, running experiments, and collecting the data that trains the next model. The team builds a portable development platform that connects to partner vehicles and brings Wayve’s model development capabilities to them, including data collection, experiment control, telemetry and over-the-air updates. It is used across our own fleet and on pre-production vehicles with OEM partners in Europe and Japan, and is central to how Wayve adapts its AI Driver to new vehicles. You will lead a team of engineers based in London, working alongside the Runtime Platform, OS, Sensors and Platform Integration teams in Robot Software. 🧠 Your day-to-day You will lead the team’s people, plans and partnerships. Most of your time goes to your engineers: regular 1:1s, clear expectations, feedback, performance and promotion cycles, and helping technical leads take on more scope. You will work with your tech leads on technical decisions, own the outcomes, and make sure the team responds well when issues come up in the field. You will maintain the team’s mission, charter and twelve-month roadmap, turn them into quarterly and six-week plans, and keep delivery on track. You will be the team’s main point of contact for partner engineering teams, programme managers, operations and OEM customers, and you will make it clear what the team owns. You will stay technically capable and aware of the team’s work across the codebase. You will monitor the architecture, guide the team through technical blockers when needed, and engage with technical leaders in other teams at a technical level. 🧩 What you’ll be working on: Growing the platform: Take the development platform from its first stable release to a product used across many vehicle types, with predictable releases and validation in CI and on HIL benches. Experiment control and fleet orchestration: Own model and controller download, the robot state machine, and over-the-air deployment of software, configuration and calibration. Self-serve experimentation: Make the platform self-serve, so research teams can run their own experiments on vehicles without waiting for platform changes. Scaling data collection: Onboard and event-based logging, data quality, and data offload over New vehicles and OEM integrations: Deploy the full platform on Wayve’s next-generation vehicles, and support new OEM integrations through configuration rather than new releases. Building the operating model around the platform: Releases, support rota, on-call, metrics and observability. Building the team: Own hiring and onboarding, and grow the team as adoption of the platform expands. 🙌 You should apply if: You have managed software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching and performance management. You have owned a platform or product that other teams or customers relied on, and shipped it to devices in the field. You are technically capable, with hands-on experience in embedded Linux systems software (C++ or Python), and stay close enough to the code to review your team’s work, guide architecture and help resolve technical blockers. You understand connected device fleets, such as vehicles, robots or IoT, including data logging and offload, over-the-air updates and observability. You are comfortable leading delivery across many stakeholders, including external partners, and can engage with other technical leaders as a technical peer. You care about operational reliability and release quality. Experience with autonomous vehicles or robotics, automotive ECUs (for example NVIDIA Jetson or DRIVE, QNX), Yocto, IPC middleware such as ROS 2 or DDS, or containerised workloads on embedded systems is desirable. 🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement. More about Wayve: 🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines. Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility. How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working: Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives. This role is based in our London office. 🔍 The Interview Process: Our process is clear and respectful of your time: Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins) Competency Interviews : leadership and management interview, and hiring manager interview; 2 hours total Deep-dive interviews : domain, systems design and code review interviews; 3 hours total Final interview : values alignment (30-45 mins) We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability. What’s in it for you (Location dependant): 💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually 📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve ✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable ✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs 📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth 🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more A quick, honest note before you apply. Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one. If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you. At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law. description: Your Mission About the Role We are looking for a proactive and commercially minded Bid Manager to lead and project manage the end-to-end tender and proposal process across our UK business. You will take ownership of each bid from early qualification and planning through to submission, clarification, handover and post-bid review. This includes setting the bid strategy, defining responsibilities, coordinating contributors, managing timelines and dependencies, and ensuring that decisions and deliverables are completed to the required quality and deadline. The role requires someone who can bring structure and momentum to complex tender processes, engage stakeholders across different functions and levels, and constructively challenge assumptions, contributions and proposed solutions. Working closely with Commercial, Operations, Delivery, Product, Legal, Finance and central teams, you will ensure that submissions are compliant, compelling, deliverable and commercially robust. Key Responsibilities Own and manage the full bid lifecycle from opportunity qualification and bid planning through to submission, clarification, contract handover and post-bid review. Develop and maintain clear bid plans covering deliverables, responsibilities, dependencies, review stages, approvals, resources and deadlines. Lead bid kick-offs, progress reviews, solution workshops and final submission reviews, creating clarity and accountability across all contributors. Coordinate and actively manage internal stakeholders, external consultants and specialist partners, challenging delays, unclear ownership or insufficient contributions. Identify bid risks, dependencies, gaps and decision requirements early, escalating where necessary to protect quality, commercial viability and timelines. Lead bid qualification and go/no-go assessments, ensuring that client requirements and commercial, technical, operational and delivery implications are fully understood. Develop the bid strategy, win themes, key messages and overall proposal structure in collaboration with relevant stakeholders. Ensure that submissions are compliant, persuasive, commercially competitive and operationally deliverable, constructively challenging assumptions and proposed commitments. This ranges from our EUC/Office environments to Trading and Core service Co-Location Data Centres, and extends to Public Cloud, delivering top-tier technology services to a dynamic and demanding Trading organisation.<br><br>In addition to meeting the round-the-clock operational demands of the platforms, we continuously evolve and transform our platforms to maintain a competitive edge that our business requires. We innovate to provide valuable solutions and leverage our skilled Technology teams to deliver against rapidly changing business requirements.</p> <p><strong>Role Overview: </strong></p> <p>As a member of our London-based Infrastructure Platform Engineering team, this position encompasses the design, engineering, and support of our multi-tenant private and public cloud initiatives. The role is integral to delivering services to our core business sectors globally, including Trading, middle and back office, and Technology.</p> <p>The role is responsible for the support and maintenance of the BlueCrest Linux estate and Automation Services, delivered via On-Premise, Colo and Public Cloud platforms, providing robust solutions based on leading technologies to enhance and support our business.</p> <p>The role delivers excellent levels of service to the business, requiring an understanding of key business processes and a solid understanding of how the solutions we deliver aid and develop our growing business. The successful candidate will understand and be involved in critical BAU and technology service delivery activities in a time-sensitive environment, whilst being innovative and implementing new solutions to enhance business performance.</p> <p>The successful candidate will follow pre-defined scopes, designs and plans to assist in implementing and supporting new and existing technology initiatives, while demonstrating clear communication skills.</p> <p><strong>Experience required: </strong></p> <ul> <li>Extensive knowledge and experience of a major Linux Enterprise Server distribution including installation, configuration, automation, administration, and support in diverse, highly dynamic, fast-paced environments - desirable: <ul> <li>SUSE Certified Administrator/Engineer (SCA/SCE), Red Hat Certified System Administrator/Engineer (RHCSA/RHCE), or equivalent Linux certification.</li> <li>Experience with container platforms and tooling, including Docker, Kubernetes, Prometheus, and GitOps, is also desirable.</li> <li>Knowledge of integrating Linux within a Windows environment, including Active Directory and Kerberos integration.</li> </ul> using tools such as Terraform, Terragrunt, and Cloud-Init.</li> <li>Advanced scripting/programming skills in Python and Bash, CI/CD pipelines, APIs, and data structures such as JSON and YAML – highly desirable.</li> <li>Experience of server hardware implementation, maintenance, monitoring, and automation using Infrastructure as Code and Ansible, including deployment and support within colocation facilities, low-latency environments, and distributed trading platforms.</li> <li>Experience supporting on-premises infrastructure, integrating it with cloud platforms, and ensuring resilience, performance, and scalability across hybrid environments.</li> <li>Experience with AI/ML workloads, AIOps, and supporting infrastructure would be beneficial.</li> <li>Technology-focused and committed to continuous learning, with the ability to deliver rapidly while balancing business constraints in fast-paced enterprise trading environments.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About you:</strong></p> <p>The ideal candidate is an experienced Infrastructure Engineer with proven hands-on experience supporting enterprise Linux platforms, with strong expertise in SUSE Linux Enterprise Server (SLES) and/or Red infrastructure solutions. Experience supporting cloud platforms and AI/ML workloads would be beneficial.</p> <p>This role would suit an enthusiastic, self-motivated individual who thrives in a pressurised environment and wants to develop their Linux and automation skills and knowledge whilst gaining a detailed understanding of business processes.</p> <p> </p> <p><em>BlueCrest is committed to providing an inclusive environment for its workforce. title: Sales Director, EMEA
description: Founded in 2018, Talos provides institutional-grade trading technology for the global digital asset market, powering many of the major players in the crypto ecosystem. Our mission is clear: to advance the mass adoption of digital assets by seamlessly connecting institutions to the digital asset ecosystem. We are committed to building the most innovative and trusted platform in the world, supporting the entire trading lifecycle. At Talos, you’ll find an environment that champions kindness and respect, values diverse perspectives, and upholds inclusivity at every turn. We believe every member of our team brings invaluable insights and abilities that drive Talos forward. In our pursuit of excellence, we foster a culture of trust, integrity, collaboration, and mutual growth. We are a tight-knit yet globally distributed team of highly experienced engineers and business leaders, with hubs in New York, London, Singapore, and Cyprus. You’ll be part of a hybrid-friendly environment where your unique talents and insights will play a crucial role in building something extraordinary. Sales Director, EMEA This is a senior sales opportunity for an experienced commercial leader to drive Talos’s growth with banks and TradFi institutions as institutional finance moves into digital assets and tokenized, multi-asset trading. As Sales Director at Talos, you will own new business and key relationships across the UK, with a focus on banks and TradFi institutions entering digital assets. You will run the full deal lifecycle, from origination and discovery through solutioning, trials and close, partnering closely with Solutions and Account Management to make sure clients are set up for long-term success. Talos runs a structured, consultative sales environment. This role suits someone with an established TradFi network, a proven record of originating revenue, and the ability to clearly articulate how institutional trading infrastructure is changing. Responsibilities Originate and close new business across banks, broker-dealers and TradFi institutions, alongside Talos’s core client segments including hedge funds, market makers, prime brokers and digital asset service providers. Use and expand your network of senior bank and TradFi relationships to build a high-quality pipeline from day one. Lead senior-level discovery and demo conversations, mapping institutional workflows and requirements to Talos’s product capabilities. Position Talos clearly within the evolving digital asset ecosystem, translating TradFi requirements across connectivity, risk, compliance and workflow into Talos’s value proposition. Manage and grow an existing book of business in partnership with Account Management, driving retention, expansion and executive-level relationships. Coordinate cross-functionally with Solutions, Account Management, Product and Engineering to advance deals and make sure client commitments are accurate and deliverable. Capture and communicate client and market insights to inform product roadmap and go-to-market strategy. Maintain disciplined pipeline management and forecasting in Salesforce. Act as a senior Talos presence in the London market, representing Talos at industry conferences and client events. Share expertise and informally mentor junior members of the sales team. Requirements 7+ years of client-facing sales or commercial experience within institutional financial services, fintech or enterprise SaaS serving capital markets. An established network of active relationships across banks and TradFi institutions, particularly in the UK and Europe. A proven track record of originating and closing new business, with quantifiable results. Deep understanding of TradFi market structure and institutional trading workflows. Experience in FX, fixed income, equities or multi-asset trading environments is highly valued. Familiarity with digital assets is advantageous but not required. You should bring genuine interest in how TradFi is adopting digital assets and tokenization. The ability to lead consultative, senior-level sales conversations and explain complex infrastructure in clear, client-friendly terms. Strong commercial judgment, with the discipline to set realistic client expectations and avoid overcommitting on product or timelines. A self-directed, high-ownership approach: you can build a pipeline and maintain momentum independently, without ramp-up or close guidance. A collaborative, team-first mindset, comfortable in a fast-paced, distributed environment with a high degree of autonomy. Based in London, or able to work from the London office. Our Sales Approach Talos operates a systematic, consultative sales process built around a simple principle: listen first, sell second . We take the time to understand a client's workflows, constraints, and goals before positioning a solution. We sell what we have - with deep product mastery and honest conversations about what's on the roadmap and what isn't. We maintain a balanced pipeline across focus segments, use Salesforce rigorously to track progress, and hand off every closed deal with a documented account plan so the relationship starts on solid footing from day one. We play the long game. Underpromise, overdeliver, and build the kind of relationships that compound over time. title: Head of Brand and Creative
description: Head of Brand and Creative The Role The UK is Lyrebird's most important new market, and you'll own how we show up in it. You'll co-develop Lyrebird's brand strategy and lead its rollout across the UK, covering media, communications, campaigns, research, partnerships, agency and budget management, and the brand measurement that proves it's working. You'll also own the creative bar for everything Lyrebird makes globally. That means the taste and quality of the work, plus the operations, agencies and systems that let in-house and external teams produce world-class creative at pace. This is a senior leadership hire at a foundational moment: you'll shape how Lyrebird looks, sounds and feels as it scales. This role suits someone who moves easily between thinking about the brand and the category and caring about the quality of a single frame. You'll enjoy setting strategy in one meeting and art-directing in the next. You get as much energy from building the system behind great work as from making it, and you can hold a room of executives as comfortably as a room of creatives. If you want real influence over business outcomes and a brand you can call your own, you'll feel at home here. About Us Lyrebird Health is transforming the quality and accessibility of healthcare by automating clinicians' most time-consuming tasks. We're building the medical intelligence layer for modern healthcare: a clinical AI platform that combines ambient real-time documentation, intelligent document management, clinical workflow automation, native patient data integrations across siloed health systems, and a communications layer that keeps clinicians and patients connected. Thousands of clinicians across multiple disciplines use Lyrebird every day in environments where accuracy, safety, and time matter deeply. We give clinicians richer patient information at the right moment and lighten their mental load during consults, so they can focus on delivering better care. Everything we build is grounded in earning trust, reducing cognitive load, and delivering meaningful impact at scale. What you'll do Co-own Lyrebird's brand strategy and lead its UK rollout. This covers positioning, media, communications and campaigns that grow brand preference and trust among UK clinicians and healthcare professionals. Set and hold the creative quality and taste bar for everything Lyrebird makes globally, whether it's made in-house or by agencies. Build the creative engine: the operations, workflows, playbooks and systems that let in-house and external teams produce world-class work at volume and pace. Select, brief and manage creative and media agencies to a high standard, and decide what we build in-house and what we outsource. Design and own a brand measurement framework for a clinical audience, and report on brand health against clear goals. Shape the research and partnerships agenda that helps build the medical AI category the right way. Work closely with growth, retention, product marketing, our clinical team, product and engineering, analytics, sales, customer success and our founders, so the brand holds together across every touchpoint. What you'll bring Senior experience leading brand strategy and creative output, either at an agency or in-house at a growth-stage company, and a body of work you're proud of. A high creative bar. You set the standard, art-direct, and give sharp direction that lifts the quality of a team's work. Operational brand media depth: planning, buying and optimising integrated campaigns across digital, OOH, streaming audio, social, professional media partnerships, conference sponsorships and sponsored content. Creative operations and agency leadership. You've built the systems and managed the partners that let great work ship at pace. An audience-first instinct backed by analytical rigour. You turn insight about a professional audience into positioning, media and creative that resonate, and you're comfortable with brand measurement, including brand lift and incrementality. Strong leadership and communication, and an AI-native approach. You build and develop talent, and you use AI across creative development, planning, research and reporting. Nice to have Familiarity with healthcare or medical audience channels, such as medical associations, clinical publications and conference media. Experience in the UK or NHS healthcare market. Comfort with dashboards and marketing measurement tools such as Tableau, Sigma or Looker, and with marketing mix modelling or incrementality studies. The work you do here will shape how clinicians first come to know and trust Lyrebird, and that trust is what lets them bring it into the care they give. The stronger the brand and the work, the more clinicians reach for Lyrebird, and the more patients feel the difference. We're building a team that reflects the diversity of the people who benefit from our work. We want Lyrebird to be a place where everyone feels safe, supported, and able to thrive. If you're from an underrepresented background in tech, we strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every requirement. Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Accounts Payable Associate
description: LemFi (Series B) is building the go-to financial app for the Global South. Moving to a new country shouldn’t mean starting from zero. That's why our team of 400+ spanning 20+ countries is building a financial ecosystem that helps immigrants stay connected to home, build stability, and create wealth regardless of where they are from or where they live. What began as fast, affordable remittances is now evolving into a complete platform for multi-currency accounts, payments, credit, and long-term financial growth. With millions of users across the globe, we process over $1B in monthly transactions to 30+ countries, proving that borders shouldn't limit financial opportunity. About the role LemFi is the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve - powering cross-border payments, multi-currency accounts, savings, and credit across 21 countries. Our Finance team sits at the centre of all of it, and the AP function is what keeps the engine running cleanly behind the scenes. Our software moves energy usage to times when electricity is cheap and green, by controlling vehicle charging, heating systems, and home batteries. We control hundreds of thousands of energy assets. We’re building in a legacy industry and moving gigawatt-hours of electrons in the real world, but we operate at lightning speed, and we’re growing the team to meet customer demand. We’re proud to be supported by world-leading investors, including Energize Capital and Accel. Read more about what we’re building here . About the role This is a wide-ranging role that’ll require you to move at speed across diverse topics; in return, you’ll gain high levels of ownership and exposure. Example topics include: entering new markets, from research & analysis to planning & delivery helping our new and existing clients get the most out of our software exploring and delivering on opportunities for growth in new verticals and customer segments This is a high-velocity, high-impact role. To succeed, you’ll need to learn quickly, act with purpose, and absorb & process highly technical information. You’ll need to be strong with data, and have a ‘run through walls’ attitude to overcome the inevitable barriers. What's in it for you A meaningful slice of equity in Axle, alongside a competitive salary, with total compensation ranging from £75k–£200k (base salary + equity). The data supports resilient navigation, Earth observation and the safe, sustainable use of space. We're a small, fast-moving team of engineers, scientists and operators in London. We're backed by venture investors and supported by ESA, the UK Space Agency, Innovate UK and the European Innovation Council. Position Overview You’ll be the operationally responsive member of the Astrodynamics team. You’ll take on a wide range of tasks, from producing analysis to demonstrate Foundational’s world leading capabilities, through customer facing discussions with the business development team to supporting customers with operational issues or special requirements. Expect to also be a key point of contact for our ground station teams to help ensure smooth functioning of our tracking network. Key Responsibilities Monitor Foundational’s orbit determination and prediction pipelines, identifying failure cases and areas for improvement Produce white papers, conference papers, and marketing materials demonstrating accuracy provided by SLR data Work closely with potential and existing customers to understand needs, and ensure they get the most from Foundational’s product offering Perform operational support for customers where necessary Support and supervise SLR tracking operations Required Operational experience working with spacecraft tracking data and orbit determination/prediction Ability to communicate with non specialists about astrodynamics, orbit determination, etc Willingness to engage with existing and potential customers to provide support Able to apply rigorous analysis to problems/datasets in astrodynamics Experience with Python, ability to build tooling to conduct analysis Nice to have Prior experience working with Business Development teams/in a sales environment Good overall understanding of the space sector Experience writing proposals What We Offer A high-impact role with real ownership at an early-stage, venture-backed spacetech company EMI share options (UK employees) Cycle to work scheme Enhanced parental leave Work alongside engineers and scientists across optics, lasers, software and astrodynamics Offices in central London with snacks, tea, coffee and regular socials Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Google Ads Specialist | E-commerce | London Hybrid (1 Day/Week) | ASAP
description: ennovationHUB is an international e-commerce group growing rapidly within the home & living sector, specialising in furniture. Operating from hubs in Belgrade, Barcelona, and London, we reach customers across the UK, North America, the EU, and APAC. With our sights set on €160m+ in annual revenue by 2027, we are hiring a Senior Google Ads Specialist to lead Google Ads performance for one of our portfolio brands. You will be directly accountable for driving growth, improving advertising efficiency, and increasing profitability. We are looking to fill this position urgently, with an immediate start available. This London-based role offers a hybrid arrangement, with one day each week at our office near High Street Kensington tube station and the rest of the week working remotely. About the Role: You will become part of an international e-commerce group managing multiple brands, where Google Ads is an established driver of growth. Working with substantial budgets across several markets, you will see a direct connection between your decisions, revenue, and business performance. Your contribution will extend beyond managing campaigns. You will explore large datasets, understand the factors behind performance, and identify opportunities that you can put into practice through testing, optimisation, and hands-on execution. In collaboration with our Head of Performance Marketing, creative team, and data specialists, you will oversee £250,000+ in monthly advertising spend across international markets. Your goal will be to achieve strong immediate results while creating the conditions for sustained, efficient, and profitable growth. Your responsibilities: Lead Google Ads performance across multiple international markets for one of our e-commerce brands Create, run, and optimise Search, Shopping, Performance Max, and other relevant campaign formats Monitor and improve ROAS, CPA, conversion rates, revenue, and profitability Be directly accountable for growth, efficiency, and overall results within your assigned brand portfolio Identify growth opportunities across products, categories, markets, and audience groups Turn campaign insights into clear recommendations and actionable improvements Conduct account audits and introduce continuous performance improvements Collaborate with developers and analytics colleagues to ensure reliable tracking and measurement Partner with creative and content teams to improve advertising results and landing page performance Support budget allocation, forecasting, and performance reporting Stay informed about Google Ads updates, AI-powered advertising tools, and industry best practices Help shape testing approaches and experimentation frameworks that improve performance over time The opportunity: Google Ads is already an important part of our commercial success. You will build on this existing foundation by finding new opportunities, increasing efficiency, and scaling campaigns that deliver results in a competitive e-commerce market. You will work with experienced colleagues who act quickly and care about outcomes. We appreciate people who think independently, use evidence to guide their decisions, and take responsibility for what they deliver. This position combines hands-on execution with real ownership. You will have the trust and freedom to make decisions, question existing approaches, and directly influence business growth. At our scale, even incremental improvements can have a significant commercial impact. Experience working within an in-house e-commerce team is essential. We will not consider candidates whose Google Ads background is primarily in agency, consultancy, or freelance work. We are seeking someone who has owned performance from inside an e-commerce business, where success is assessed through revenue, profitability, customer acquisition, and sustainable growth. You should be ready to take responsibility for commercial outcomes and implement your own decisions, with involvement that extends beyond providing recommendations or delivering campaigns. What we are looking for: A minimum of 2 years of practical experience managing Google Ads campaigns A track record of owning Google Ads performance within an e-commerce business, with direct accountability for results and profitability Thorough working knowledge of Search, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns Proven experience as part of an in-house e-commerce team Confidence working with large datasets and extracting insights that inform practical action A sound understanding of attribution, tracking, and performance measurement Familiarity with Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Merchant Center Strong analytical thinking and careful attention to detail Fluent written and spoken English The ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced setting where priorities can change An inquisitive, proactive mindset and a consistent focus on improvement The confidence to make decisions independently and accept responsibility for the results An openness to using AI and automation as we continue expanding their application across the business Availability to join immediately or at the earliest possible opportunity How you approach your work: You combine senior-level judgment with a practical approach to execution. Your decisions are grounded in data, and you know how to translate analysis into concrete steps. You actively look for opportunities to improve, remain curious about what drives performance, and keep commercial outcomes in focus. You are comfortable moving between strategic planning and daily campaign management, with a strong motivation to build and scale. Location and travel: We are investing further in London and anticipate that it will play a growing role as one of our business hubs. Our broader team is based across London, Belgrade, Barcelona, Frankfurt, Oxfordshire, Istanbul, and Guangzhou. You will also travel approximately every 4–8 weeks to Belgrade, Barcelona, or other team locations. These trips bring colleagues together for planning, workshops, team events, and strategic discussions. As we grow, we continue to value regular time together in person alongside the flexibility of remote work. Our culture: At ennovationHUB, we value: Taking ownership and being accountable for outcomes Putting ideas into practice Communicating clearly and directly Developing knowledge through hands-on experience We welcome colleagues from a wide range of backgrounds who take pride in their work, accept responsibility, and want to help the business move forward. This is a long-term opportunity to play a meaningful part in the continued growth of an international e-commerce group. Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow
